pattern.description: Closing the Columns configuration panel snaps the view back to its normal layout: the panel disappears, the board widens to show a fourth column, and the header actions (avatars, Comment, Share, About this view, search) return.
pattern.why_premium: The configure-then-reveal rhythm lets the narration line 'your ideas will automatically be organized' land on a clean, full board with no transition effect needed.

build_hint.gsap: Single-frame state swap: tl.set('.columns-panel', {autoAlpha: 0}); tl.set('.view-header-actions, .search', {autoAlpha: 1}, '<'); tl.set('.columns-btn', {className: 'btn btn-subtle'}, '<'). Optional polish: .from('.board-col:nth-child(4)', {opacity: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power1.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Conditional render on frame >= closeFrame: hide the panel and render header actions plus the fourth column; no spring, hard toggle (optional 4-frame opacity interpolate on the revealed column).

notes: Energy shows a single-frame spike (f3771); the panel removal is a hard state change, not an animated slide.
